feeds.title: The Shoe Snob Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to The Shoe Snob Blog! This blog was created to not only show the journey of one man, Justin FitzPatrick, who wanted to make the shoe industry the best it could be but also the share all of the knowledge gained along the way. Ultimately this blog is about seeing men wearing better shoes through education and sharing what is out there that deserves recognition.

feeds.title: The Cheaney Blog
feeds.description: During the first 80 years of business, the factory made shoes exclusively for some of the finest retailers around the world, branded to their individual company requirements.

feeds.title: Wide Shoe Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to our Wide Fitting Shoe Blog. We have over 40 years of experience in helping people who have wide feet. Come and see our op tips on looking after your feet, choosing the right footwear as well as spotlights on wide fitting brands and latest styles. Advise on the best shoes for bunions, corns and other foot conditions.

feeds.title: Gaborshoes Blog
feeds.description: The Gabor Shoes blog provides you information on everything you need to know about how to care for your favourite pair of shoes and what are the best shoes for every occasion. Gabor shoes was founded in Germany in 1949 by Joachim and Bernhard Gabor, and is now run by Joachim Gabor's son, Achim. Since their creation, Gabor shoes have become globally celebrated for their comfort and style.

feeds.title: Northern Runner Blog
feeds.description: The Northern Runner Blog brings you Running Shoe Reviews, Local Running News & Results and a lot more! Stocking only specialist running brands and equipment, Northern Runner is Newcastle's premier runner's shop. With a dedicated staff of active runners providing expert advice and assistance, we operate from our city centre location on Low Friar Street and from our online shop - offering UK and international delivery on running shoes, clothing and accessories.

feeds.title: Lotus Shoes Blog
feeds.description: Read about our latest products and collections on the Lotus Shoes blog. With a history spanning 250 years, Lotus has an outstanding reputation for offering women and men a variety of essential footwear styles that are of exceptional quality and fit.

feeds.title: Mod Shoes Blog
feeds.description: The Mod Shoes blog tells you about our shoes, the history behind them, and a lot more about our brand. The aim of Mod Shoes is to provide Smart Shoes For Smart People. We sell shoes that we think are on a different level to the High Street. You can buy some decent shoes on some high streets, but not all, and even then you have to search them out.

feeds.title: Shoegarden Blog
feeds.description: Discover exclusives, special offers and our newest collections for women, men and children. We are passionate about comfortable shoes and natural materials. Haflinger wool slippers, Stegmann leather clogs, Glerups felt slippers and Shepherd sheepskin slippers are our special shoes of interest. Shoegarden offers the biggest and best selection of Haflinger wool, felt and leather slippers and clogs in the UK.

feeds.title: Diane Hassall Blog
feeds.description: Check out the Diane Hassall blog for tips on how to select the right pair of shoes for your wedding day and many more tips related to footwear. Di is an exceedingly passionate and talented shoe artist who has designed footwear alongside industry experts throughout her 25-year career.

feeds.title: Calla Shoes Blog
feeds.description: News on the business, collections, and designs. See what's new at Calla and stay up to date as we grow the business and continue providing you with comfort. At Calla, our mission is to bring comfort back into footwear. To make you feel like you're walking on clouds.

feeds.title: Barker Shoes Blog
feeds.description: Barker Shoes have been an English tradition for 140 years. Only the most carefully selected leathers are used and the uppers are shaped on the last by hand. Many other traditional shoemaking methods are still employed including slow natural drying and polishing. Visit our blog to read the news and updates from our Earls Barton Factory.

feeds.title: size.co.uk Blog
feeds.description: Updates and musings from the global supplier of footwear and garments by a collection of the world's best brands. founded back in 2000, size? has proudly specialised in supplying the UK, Ireland and the rest of the world with the finest brands in footwear, apparel and accessories.

feeds.title: En Brogue
feeds.description: En Brogue is a blog about stylish flat shoes written and illustrated by Hannah Rochell, Fashion Features Editor at InStyle magazine in London. You'll find nothing on here but stylish flat shoes and inspiration on how to wear them, along with a few of my illustrations to boot.

feeds.title: Shoegal
feeds.description: Shoegal brings you style diary and the best of the British high street for shoe lovers. The style blogger is based in Leeds, West Yorkshire.

feeds.title: Bespoke Shoes Unlaced
feeds.description: This blog is for people who want to make shoes by hand; or those who aspire to it; or those who simply share our interest in shoemaking. Carreducker's mission is to make the most beautiful, must-have men's shoes, traditionally crafted in England with a contemporary aesthetic.

feeds.title: Shoe Stack Blog
feeds.description: Shoe Stack offer a range of Clear Front Shoe Boxes that will suit all your shoe storage needs! We are Shoe Enthusiasts that provide unique and innovative shoe accessories. If your looking for the best way to store your shoes, then look no further.

feeds.title: London Brogues Blog
feeds.description: Each season we'll be launching exciting collections that will freshen your look and break the rules when it comes to classic brogues, Oxfords, and boots. London Brogues was founded in 2014 and is headed by Derek Moore aka 'the Boss'. Derek has over 30 years of experience in the footwear industry and a passion for creating high quality items that won't break the bank.

feeds.title: CeCe and Me Blog
feeds.description: Sharing our knowledge about children's footwear and foot health to help you look after their growing feet, plus insights into our and other local businesses around Wandsworth and Wimbledon. CeCe & Me is all about making shopping for your children's shoes a calm and enjoyable experience for all involved.

feeds.title: Herring Shoes Journal
feeds.description: Visit the Herring Shoes Journal to know about our sole mates, shoe gifting ideas, how to care for your shoes, and a lot more. Herring Shoes is an English family business which was started in 1966 by Richard Herring. Our purpose is to supply top quality shoes from English manufacturers such as Barker, Church's, Cheaney and Loake with service to match through our website and retail shops.

feeds.title: Original Cobblers Blog
feeds.description: Original Cobblers Blog informs you about our updates and also tells you about shoe care and repair. We are a bespoke boot and shoe repair service with excellent attention to detail using top quality materials.

feeds.title: Shoe Lab Blog
feeds.description: Find out about the latest shoe trends, shoe gifting ideas, our services and much more. Shoe Lab UK is a Shoe, Trainer and Bag Cleaning and Restoration Service. We take shoes/bags that look ready for the bin and make them box fresh again!

feeds.title: Scarpa Blog
feeds.description: Read our blog to know about our latest products and their uses. Based in Asolo, Italy, Scarpa have been producing handmade boots since 1930. We continue to lead the way in product development with new, exciting collections being unveiled all the time. Scarpa has been owned and operated by the Parisotto family since 1956, and they remain at the forefront of the business.
